rules.title: Ban on algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy
rules.requirement: Selling or using an algorithmic device to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco is prohibited. This covers software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents for vacant units.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential units in San Francisco; applies to sellers and users (landlords) of algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor rental data.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Whether the landlord or vendor uses an algorithmic device analyzing nonpublic competitor rental data

rules.penalty: A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action against an entity violating the law.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
